name: io.github.LogeshR15/screener-mcp
title: Screener Stock Research
description: Indian stock research (BSE/NSE) via Screener.in: financials, screens, filings, earnings calls.

environmentVariables.name: SCREENER_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Screener.in login email. Optional; without it only public data is available and fundamental screens are disabled.

environmentVariables.name: SCREENER_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Screener.in password. Optional; pair with SCREENER_USERNAME.
